title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378V (Meetings of Board and quorum)

content.overview: A meeting of the Board shall be held not less than once in every three months and at least four such meetings shall be held in every year. Notice of every Board meeting shall be given in writing to every director for the time being in India and at his usual address in India to every other director. The Chief Executive shall give not less than seven days’ prior notice (penalty of five thousand rupees for failure), though a meeting may be called at shorter notice with reasons recorded in writing. Quorum is one-third of the total strength of directors, subject to a minimum of three. Directors (including co-opted directors) may be paid such fees and allowances for attendance as the Members decide in general meeting, save as provided in the articles.
content.glance: At least four Board meetings a year (once every three months); 7-day notice by the Chief Executive; quorum one-third subject to minimum three; attendance fees fixed by Members.
content.study: Section 378V fixes the frequency of Board meetings, the notice duty of the Chief Executive, quorum, and the power of Members to fix attendance fees. Shorter notice is permitted if reasons are recorded. The quorum rule is one-third of total strength with a floor of three directors.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Board meetings at least once every three months (minimum four a year); 7-day written notice by the Chief Executive; quorum one-third subject to minimum three; attendance fees as Members decide.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378V
examples.body: A Producer Company with nine directors needs a quorum of three (one-third subject to minimum three) for a valid Board meeting under s. 378V(4).

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378V?
hypotheticals.analysis: It fixes Board-meeting frequency, notice, quorum and attendance-fee rules for Producer Companies.

rows.right: Committee of directors (s. 378U) or Chief Executive (s. 378W)

misconceptions.trap: Treating this section as a books-of-account provision.
misconceptions.correction: s. 378V is Meetings of Board and quorum; books of account are a different provision.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378V be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Check meeting frequency. II. Confirm notice and quorum. III. Note attendance-fee rule.
